sloka: मातृभिर्भ्रातृसहितं पश्यामो ऽद्य वयं नृप ।दिष्ट्या प्रहस्तो विकटो विरूपाक्षो महोदरः ।अकम्पनश्च दुर्धर्षो निहतास्ते निशाचराः ।। ७.१.२१ ॥
transliteration: mātṛbhirbhrātṛsahitaṁ paśyāmo 'dya vayaṁ nṛpa ।diṣṭyā prahasto vikaṭo virūpākṣo mahodaraḥ ।akampanaśca durdharṣo nihatāste niśācarāḥ ।। 7.1.21 ॥

translations.english: O King, we are fortunate to see you today with our mothers and brothers, and it is by good fortune that those demons Prahasta, Vikata, Virupaksha, Mahodara, Akampana, and Durdharsha have been killed.
